_description: Canonical SIMD route ledger for fgf 3.0.2. Edited by hand; checked by benches/simd_ledger.py. Obligations are expanded from applicability × rules × callables. Cell default: status=unverified, required=false, perf=unmeasured.

exclusions.residue-gf2: GF(2) residue add is XOR; use bits family

exclusions.residue-u8-low: Residue packing uses identity encode or prime reduce
exclusions.residue-u8-high: Residue packing uses identity encode or prime reduce
exclusions.residue-gf2: Residue GF(2) packing uses identity encode

row-mul-into.justification: Same lane/loss as accumulate; write-only destination

matrix-mul-add.justification: Matrix AXPY uses same vector geometry as row AXPY

scatter-mul-add.justification: Scatter resolves to per-row AXPY; same lane/loss

gather-mul-add.justification: Gather transpose-resolves to per-row AXPY; same lane/loss

elementwise-mul.justification: Elementwise multiplication; one row per call

elementwise-div.justification: Division scope: mul elementwise by inverse

elementwise-inv.justification: Batch inversion; same vector width as elements

dot-product.justification: Dot product over row pair; one accumulation pass

pack.justification: Pack canonical elements to bytes; target-basis bytes

unpack.justification: Unpack bytes to canonical elements; source-basis bytes

unit-accumulate.justification: One-coefficient accumulate pairs; same vector geometry

bits-and.justification: GF(2) bits: lane = vec_bytes*8 bits; loss = 2*(vec_bytes-1)*8 bits

bits-xor.justification: GF(2) XOR: lane = vec_bytes*8 bits; loss = 2*(vec_bytes-1)*8 bits

bits-dot.justification: Bit dot product; same as xor

bits-set-range.justification: Set/clear ranges operate on contiguous bits

map-words.justification: Map word strides: vec_bytes / 8B words; loss = 2*(vec_bytes-1)/8B rounded up
